x-e-e6-04.goal: Sara tableaux mingi tî votes mo même so claim anglais 'ni awara votes mingi ahon, me ayeke moitié tî classe ape' ayeke vrai.
x-e-e6-04.material: 20 élèves na yâ tî classe ôko ôko amû ôko vote tî activité na pekoni tî temps tî snack: football, art, wala musique. A fa votes tongana s (football), a (art), na m (musique).

x-e-e6-04.thinking.1: Sara exemples so asatisfaire conditions mingi na ôko
x-e-e6-04.prereq.1: Sens tî most, fewer than, half
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.prompt: Résultat ayeke football votes 8, art votes 6, musique votes 6. Phrase wa afa ni nzoni mingi?
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ajouter 8, 6, na 6, gi moitié tî 20 élèves, na sara comparaison.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sara comparaison tî so 'most' na 'everyone' ôko ôko atene.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.a: Vérifier so conditions use kûê aconfirmer na nömörö.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.c: Sara comparaison mbeni lâ so 8 ayeke kota wala kêtê ahon 10.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.explain: 8 votes ayeke kota ahon art (6) na musique (6), ndali ni ayeke the most, na ayeke kêtê ahon 10 so ayeke moitié tî 20, ndali ni ayeke moitié ape. Ndali ni a ayeke correct.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.prompt: Sara tableaux tî votes 3 nde nde so total ayeke 20 élèves so claim même ('football awara votes mingi ahon, me moitié ape') ayeke vrai.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.0: Football lingbi tî awara mingi ahon, ndali ni commencer na sï valeur so ayeke kota ahon art na musique.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.1: Fixer football na ôko valeur, na pekoni zî ni na 20 na partager ye so angbâ na art na musique. Tongana football ayeke kêtê mingi, mo lingbi tî si na 20 ape.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Votes ayeke nombres entiers 0 wala kota.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Sû votes tongana nombres entiers 0 wala kota.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Football ayeke na votes mingi ahon.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Football ayeke na votes mingi ahon art wala musique ape.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c4: Football ayeke na gbe tî moitié (votes 10).
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.explain: Tî so football ayeke na votes mingi ahon, art na musique ôko ôko alingbi tî ayeke kêtê ahon s, na somme tî ala ayeke 20-s. Tongana s=7, a+m=13, ndali ni ala use alingbi tî ayeke 6 wala kêtê ape, ndali ni ni akpe, na tongana s ayeke 10 wala kota ni ayeke moitié. Ndali ni s alingbi tî ayeke gï 8 wala 9.

x-e-e6-05.title: Ôko parapluie so ayeke mouillé alingbi tî tene na e 'a-ayeke na pluie lâ so'?
x-e-e6-05.topic: Hypothèse so a bata na yâ tî claim kêtê
x-e-e6-05.goal: Gi prémisse so Mia asû na raisonnement kêtê tî lo me lo tene ni ape, na sara situation na anglais so prémisse so ayeke ape.
x-e-e6-05.material: Mia atene, "Dan aga na yâ tî classe na parapluie mouillé. Ndali ni ayeke na pluie na ndö lâ so."
x-e-e6-05.thinking.0: Gi prémisse so a tene ni ape
x-e-e6-05.thinking.1: Sara situation tî contre-exemple so prémisse akpe
x-e-e6-05.thinking.2: Tene conditions so claim ayeke vrai na yâ ni
x-e-e6-05.prereq.0: Anzo tî ndo ngangu tongana wet, rain, outside
x-e-e6-05.prereq.1: Mo lingbi tî lire ndali so asi na because/so
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.prompt: Pensée so Mia atene ni ape, me lo lingbi tî crois ni tî so 'it is raining outside now' aga ndali ni, ayeke nyen?
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ague na pekoni ôko ôko étape na conclusion tî Mia na bâ ye so a bezoin tî so 'parapluie ayeke mouillé' afa so 'ayeke na pluie lâ so'.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.hint.1: Sara séparation tî faits so a sû awe na yâ tî texte na croyances so a sû ni ape.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.a: Ni ayeke fait so ayeke na yâ tî texte awe. Vérifier so ni ayeke pensée so a vuko ni.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.b: Ni ayeke usage général tî parapluies. Pensée so ni ayeke lien so raisonnement so abezoin tâ wala pëpe.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.c: Ni atene na pont so asara traversée tî 'mouillé' na 'ayeke na pluie lâ so'.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.d: Ni ayeke scène so a sû awe na yâ tî texte.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.explain: Tî tene so parapluie ayeke mouillé ndali tî pluie lâ so, mo bezoin prémisse so cause nde ayeke ape. Parapluie alingbi tî ga mouillé atâa tongana pluie akpe awe, tongana a laver parapluie, wala tongana ni atomber na yâ tî ngu.
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.prompt: Sû ôko phrase anglais na ndö tî situation so conclusion tî Mia ayeke erreur. Tene ndali so parapluie ayeke mouillé me ayeke na pluie lâ so ape.
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.hint.0: Pensée na ye nde na pluie so asara parapluie mouillé. (ngu, temps, ndo)
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.hint.1: Situation tî temps nde alingbi nga, tongana 'The rain has already stopped.'
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Na yâ tî situation so mo sû, parapluie ayeke mouillé me ayeke na pluie lâ so ape?
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mo lingbi tî bâ ndali so croyance tî Mia (cause nde ayeke ape) ayeke erreur?

x-e-e6-07.title: Sû kiri so arefuser na politesse invitation tî anniversaire tî ami
x-e-e6-07.goal: Sara tri tî parties so kiri so arefuser invitation abezoin (merci, refus clair, ndali, alternative), na sû ni mo même na anglais.
x-e-e6-07.material:
Ami tî mo Sam asara message.

Hi! Can you come to my birthday party on Saturday at 2 p.m.? It is at my house. Please tell me by Wednesday.

Me mo ayeke na voyage tî famille na Saturday, ndali ni mo lingbi tî ague ape. Ni ayeke brouillon tî kozo tî kiri tî mo: "I can't come to your party. Bye."
x-e-e6-07.thinking.0: Sara comparaison tî refus vague na refus clair
x-e-e6-07.thinking.1: Sï parties so abâ sentiments tî zo nde
x-e-e6-07.thinking.2: Sû mo même alingbi na zo so alire
x-e-e6-07.prereq.0: Expressions tongana can't / thank you for ~
x-e-e6-07.prereq.1: Anzo tî ndo ngangu tongana Saturday, next week
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.prompt: Changements wa alingbi tî aga brouillon so na ndö na kiri nzoni ahon so arefuser invitation? Sï kûê so alingbi.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.hint.0: Pensée so Sam alingbi tî ayeke tongana nyen na pekoni tî lo wara ni, na gi ye so brouillon ayeke manquer.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.hint.1: Pensée ndali wa Sam abezoin tî wara kiri tî sï na Wednesday, na sara comparaison tî information so choix ôko ôko amû na Sam.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.a: Pensée so Sam alingbi tî décider kiri tî sï na Wednesday.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.b: Ni ayeke action so akozo aconnaître sentiments tî zo nde.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.c: Sara comparaison tî so zo nde abâ tongana nyen tongana ndali ayeke na ndo ni na tongana ayeke ape.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.d: Ni ayeke lege tî bata relation na pekoni tî refuser.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.explain: Commencer na merci na suggérer lâ nde asara so refus aga froid ape. 'Maybe' asara so ayeke ngangu tî Sam tî sara plans, na tî zia ndali alingbi tî ayeke négligence.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.prompt: Sû kiri na Sam na phrases anglais use wala ota. Mû merci, refus clair (na ndali), na suggestion nde. Ndali alingbi ape tî ayeke voyage tî famille.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.hint.0: Sû ôko phrase ôko ôko na ordre so: merci, tene so mo lingbi tî ague ape, suggestion.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.hint.1: Sara kua na mot clair tongana can't / cannot na yâ tî refus, na kângbi ndali na because wala so.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ni ayeke na merci, refus clair, ndali, na suggestion?
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Na pekoni tî lire ni, Sam alingbi tî hînga clairement "mo lingbi tî ga ape"?
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ton ayeke anglais so alingbi na ami?
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Kiri so asï na lï na suggérer lâ nde.
